'''December 1999 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, New York on 11 December 1999. [[Matt Ehrhart]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d141">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-williston-park-new-york-12-11-99d141/ williston-park-new-york-12-11-99], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 11 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-williston-park-new-york-12-11-99d141/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 December 1999
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, New York
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]
